prior writes; that read-contract change is not used here.

## Root-scheduled commands

Run one fresh child/clone per command. There is no automatic matrix. Start
with B0 then C; reverse with C then B0 in a later root-granted window. The
same complete command applies with the table's runtime/binding/output:

```sh
UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE=4 node adapter/benchmark-antijoin-cost.mjs \
  --runtime SELECTED_RUNTIME \
  --candidate-binding evidence/antijoin-native-write-candidate-binding-v2-20261105.json \
  --sdk-binding SELECTED_BINDING \
  --budget evidence/antijoin-cost-10m-budget-20261105.json \
  --fixture ../../../../research-reference/projects/temporal-datalog/runtime/build/scale-runs/20261105T194343420Z-abf92aa7/facts-10000000.duckdb \
  --evidence ../../../../research-reference/projects/temporal-datalog/runtime/build/combined-028-20261105/mixed-10m-pilot.json \
  --output FRESH_OUTPUT \
  --screen large --readers 16 --samples 20 --warmup 1 --duration-seconds 60 --threads 4
```

No `--read-admission` argument is allowed.

`forward-b0-16.json`, `forward-candidate-16.json`, then

Each arm still needs 20 fixed samples/client, one warmup, 60s mixed,
maxWrites 12000, all eight limits, exact typed answers at returned K,
1,680,202 exact/minus-one input proof, every complete 10s write window,
consecutive receipts, all logical clients/physical port observations,
drain/reuse/final/reopen and full reference/selected/native/source-after
checks. Before/after hashes include the actual SDK dependency chain and all
445 selected frozen files; no source/artifact edits during a timed pair.

Evaluate and report the original eight numerical limits separately for B0
and C in both orders. C must pass 8/8 in each order. A B0 numerical miss
motivates the proposed change and does not by itself stop the remaining
authorized comparison arm; preserve it under B0's actual failed-budget
status. Identity, typed-oracle or lifecycle failures stop and preserve the
affected arm and comparison. Do not retry or change thresholds in response
to a first result. A command's nonzero exit due only to `failed_budget` is
therefore distinct from an identity/oracle/lifecycle failure.

For each fresh pair, report candidate/control relative QPS, fixed and mixed
p50/p99 latency, ACK count/rate and sampled RSS deltas alongside both arms'
absolute values and original eight gates. Retain order, source/artifact
pins, sample counts, windows and drain, so an improvement in reader tails
can be assessed alongside writer progress or memory regressions. These
relative deltas inform root's tradeoff review; they are not a new relative
hard gate or permission to relax an original limit. Do not substitute the
prior absolute-screen candidate for a fresh arm of either pair.

Fixed p99 and sampled RSS retain their existing statistical/physical limits.
Root decides subsequent regression and promotion gates; no universal
performance claim is made.
